description: Fresh query and extraction targets for the optional relevance stage. Use recall-v2.json as background memories only. Freeze this file before running before/after comparisons; all entities and values are fictional.

sources.note: Authored before model evaluation. No target fact IDs or query strings are reused from v2. Retrieval and extraction cases are scored separately; no independent semantic adjudication is implied.

memories.text: Arden's production request timeout is 18 seconds.
Arden's staging request timeout is 180 seconds.
Boreal production deployments require three reviewers.
Boreal staging deployments require one reviewer.
Crest retains authentication audit logs for ninety days.
Crest retains sampled request metrics for nine days.
Drift writes its checkpoint before acknowledging a completed import.
Drift retries failed idempotent imports at most three times.
Eon uses SQLite for its offline cache.
Eon uses PostgreSQL for its central ledger.
Flux supports only TLS 1.3 on its public listener.
Flux requires mutual TLS between its workers.
Grove limits a batch to 64 records.
Grove limits an individual request body to 64 kilobytes.
Haven does not retry requests rejected for invalid credentials.
Haven retries network timeouts after two seconds.
Ilex has proposed remote backups but has not approved their rollout.
Juno requires authentication for remote metrics requests.
Kinetic publishes metrics at the case-sensitive path /v3/metrics.
Larch represents invoice totals as integer cents.
Meridian runs browser workflow tests with Playwright.
Nova permits 120 events per minute per client.
Oriel issues read-only tokens for monitoring clients.
Pinnacle stores event timestamps in UTC.
Morrow compresses its backups with Zstandard and encrypts them with AES-256.
